messages:
Lina Chen: PrimeWave dedicated pool bring-up — quick sync. We need final quotas, autoscale window, and load test plan. Go/no-go by EOD Wed. @Anita can you confirm PM ok?
Anita Rao: PM ok. Renewal touchpoint on Fri; they expect dedicated infra next week. If we slip it becomes a renewal risk.
Marcus Hale: SRE here. Quota check done. We can provision up to 12 GPUs for the reserved pool, propose initial cap at 10. Autoscale policy suggestion: min=2, target=8, max=12 with a +2 spike buffer.
Devon Patel: Eng-runtime notes: model warmup via prefix KV priming. Recommend batch_size=8 and quant profile q4_0 for cost/latency balance. For load tests plan to simulate ~500 concurrent sessions, peak ~5k RPS. Example test command below.
Devon Patel: ```
# k6 example run
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 15m scripts/primewave_session.js
# session script does KV priming then streaming request
```
Riya Kapoor: PrimeWave ops — we can run heavy staging tests Thu 22:00 UTC. Need a fallback window to rollback to hosted small-model variant if things degrade. I'll confirm operator availability.
Tomas Berg: CS Ops taking traffic orchestration. Ramp plan suggestion: 5k tokens/min -> 20k tokens/min over 45m (3 steps). I'll own the rollback playbook and post it here. Also linking enablement checklist in the post.
infra-bot: Provision request req-99823 accepted. Pool provisioning ETA ~2h. Smoke endpoint will be live after healthy checks.
Lina Chen: Two asks before EOD: 1) Marcus confirm autoscale cooldowns and primary metric (latency vs queued requests) 2) Devon share exact load script + expected failure modes we should watch for.
Marcus Hale: Cooldowns: scale-up 60s, scale-down 300s. Primary signals: p95 latency (target < 0.9s) and queued request count > 50 triggers scale-up. If p95 > 1.2s we trigger auto-fallback to smaller model variant for this route.
Devon Patel: Pushed load script to repo: https://git.internal/redwood/loadtests/primewave — k6 script simulates session-level KV warmup and streaming. Example quick-smoke: ```k6 run --vus 20 --duration 2m scripts/primewave_session.js```
Anita Rao: I'll update PrimeWave and schedule the 22:00 test. Riya, can you collect operator contacts and sign-off? I'll join the call.
Riya Kapoor: On it. DM-ing on-call list now and setting up access for their SRE. Also created feedback form: https://forms.company/primewave-onboard
Tomas Berg: Rollback playbook (summary): 1) shift route weight back to hosted (0.8), 2) scale down reserved pool, 3) purge KVS and reset caches, 4) open incident channel and run postmortem. I'll paste full steps before the run.
Lina Chen: Can we run a quick low-traffic smoke right now? infra-bot said ~2h but if we can exercise 2-node config we can catch issues early.
Marcus Hale: We can do a minimal smoke. Devon — please run `k6 --vus 20 --duration 2m scripts/primewave_session.js` against staging endpoint: https://staging.primewave.redwood/api/generate
Devon Patel: Running now. Early numbers: cold start ~1.1s, warm p95 ~0.45s, no errors so far. Posting small log excerpt.
Devon Patel: ```
[2026-03-21T18:02:12Z] request=200 latency=0.45s session_id=abcd1234
[2026-03-21T18:02:50Z] request=200 latency=0.48s session_id=efgh5678
```
Lina Chen: :thumbsup: Great. We'll proceed with the 22:00 full run unless something changes. I'll post the final go/no-go in this thread after the test and capture feedback for the renewal playbook.
Tomas Berg: I'll also add a short checklist for CS enablement post-run: operator contacts, SSO keys, KMS rotation note, and a short product training session link.
Anita Rao: Thanks everyone. If we hit any red thresholds during the run, we follow Tomas's rollback and open an incident channel. Otherwise I'll confirm handoff to ops and mark onboarding as "ready for customer".
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: full-loadtest Thu 22:00 UTC — channel #oncall notifies 10m prior.
Lina Chen: Aiming to capture post-run notes and retention items (feedback forms + suggested next steps). See you all after the run.
